data.explanation: Your study place is reserved but enrolment isn't finished yet. Send certified (not scanned or plain) copies of your bachelor's degree certificate and transcript of records, plus certified German or English translations, so they physically arrive at the International Office by 24 August 2027. If they arrive later, the university will give your place to someone else, so plan enough time for certification, translation and postage. If you're unsure how to get certified translations, your issuing university or a sworn translator can help.
